name: Spiperone
summary: Spiperone, also known as spiroperidol and sold under the brand name Spiropitan ((JP)) is a typical antipsychotic of the butyrophenone family related to haloperidol. It is approved for clinical use in Japan as a treatment for schizophrenia.

pharmacology.text: Spiperone interacts with various monoamine receptors. Additionally, spiperone was identified by compound screening to be an activator of Ca2+ activated Cl− channels (CaCCs), thus a potential target for therapy of cystic fibrosis.

uses.text: Spiperone, also known as spiroperidol and sold under the brand name Spiropitan ((JP)) is a typical antipsychotic of the butyrophenone family related to haloperidol. It is approved for clinical use in Japan as a treatment for schizophrenia.

sideEffects.en: As a typical antipsychotic of the haloperidol family, it can be expected to cause stiffness, tremor, restlessness and drowsiness, and rarely neuroleptic malignant syndrome, a dangerous reaction with fever and rigid muscles.
sideEffects.zh: 作為氟哌啶醇家族的典型抗精神病藥，可預期它會造成肌肉僵硬、顫抖、坐立不安與嗜睡，少數情況下可能出現抗精神病藥物惡性症候群，這是一種伴隨發燒與肌肉僵直的危險反應。
sideEffects.zhHans: 作为氟哌啶醇家族的典型抗精神病药，可预期它会造成肌肉僵硬、颤抖、坐立不安与嗜睡，少数情况下可能出现抗精神病药物恶性症候群，这是一种伴随发烧与肌肉僵直的危险反应。

fact.en: Spiperone was made by Janssen, the company behind haloperidol. In a radioactively labelled form it was used in some of the first brain scans to map dopamine receptors in living people.
fact.zh: Spiperone由開發氟哌啶醇的楊森藥廠所研製。它的放射性標記版本曾用於最早期的一批腦部造影，在活人身上描繪出多巴胺受體的分布。
fact.zhHans: Spiperone由开发氟哌啶醇的杨森药厂所研制。它的放射性标记版本曾用于最早期的一批脑部造影，在活人身上描绘出多巴胺受体的分布。
